Virtue (D0 Tran): Gives touched 1 temporary HP for 1 min
Wall Of Fire (D5 Evoc): R300' Creates a 400'x20' wall or a 50'x20' ring that inflicts 2d4 HP fire to creatures within 10', 1d4 HP fire to creatures within 20', and 2d6+20 HP fire when passing through (or double these damages to undead) for concentration + 20 rd
Wall Of Stone (D6 Conj): R300' Creates a 100 square foot, 5"-thick permanent stone wall (the area can be doubled by halving the thickness); each 5' section has 75 hit points and hardness 8
Wall Of Thorns (D5 Conj): R300' Creates 200 cubic feet of thorns that inflict (25-Armor Class) HP slashing, discounting Dexterity and dodge bonuses to AC, for 200 min; moving through the thorns requires a Strength check each rd, allowing 5' of movement for each 5 points that the check exceeds 20
Warp Wood (D2 Tran): R75' Warps or straightens 20 wooden objects in a 20' radius (save Will negates)
Water Breathing (D3 Tran): Allows touched creatures to breathe underwater for a total of 40 hrs
Whirlwind (D8 Evoc): R1200' 10' radius, 30' high cyclone moves 60' as directed each rd, inflicting 3d6 HP on Large and smaller creatures (save Reflex negates), for 20 rd; it traps Medium and smaller creatures (save Reflex negates), inflicting an additional 1d8 HP on each subsequent rd
Wind Walk (D7 Tran): Allows self and 6 touched to spend 5 rd changing to and from a translucent vapor that can move 60 MPH, for 20 hr
Wind Wall (D3 Evoc): R300' Creates a 200'x100'x2' curtain of air that scatters objects, bars gasses and Small or smaller flying creatures, and deflects arrows and bolts for 20 rd
Wood Shape (D2 Tran): Reshapes a 30 cubic feet piece of wood (save Will negates)
Word Of Recall (D8 Conj): Self and 6 willing touched return to a chosen sanctuary
Magic Notes:
Wisdom Druid Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level D1, D2, D3
A Thousand Faces: Can change appearance at will while in normal form
Aligned Spells: Cannot cast spells with an alignment opposed to own or deity's alignment
Enlarge Spell: May use +1 spell slot to dbl chosen spell range
Lightning Lord: Can use Call Lightning effects on targets within 15' for 20 bolts per day
Maximize Spell: May use +3 spell slot to maximize all variable effects on chosen spell
Orisons: Knows 0-level spells
Speak With Animals: Can use Speak With Animals effects for 23 rd per day
Spontaneous Casting (Druid): Can cast Summon Nature's Ally spells in place of prepared spells
Wild Shape: Can change into a diminutive to huge animal, a small to huge plant, or a small to huge elemental for 20 hr at will
